title: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct FP8 on vLLM: 128GB unified or 72GB multi-GPU
slug_note: Official FP8 (31.2GB) fits one GB10 box or a 72GB multi-GPU lane with the full 256K context in reach.

variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-26 test

engine.config: Stock vLLM serve; 256K context on 128GB unified memory, reduce max-model-len on smaller pools

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-26): 111.3 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (vLLM default --gpu-memory-utilization (0.9), so this is the reservation, not the model's minimum need). That is vLLM's 0.9 reservation of the shared pool, not the model's minimum need. Earlier estimate: 31.2GB weights; the full 256K KV pool needs the 128GB boxes, the 72GB multi-GPU lane wants a shorter cap.

caveats: Size computed from the HF API.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-26), in vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0 with the HF cache mounted: server ready 411 s after `docker run` (weights from local disk, kernel autotune included); the functional check passed. 111.3 GiB dropped from MemAvailable is vLLM's default 0.9 reservation of the 128 GB pool, not the model's minimum need.
